name: application-countdown
title: Countdown
description: Countdown timer components for sales, launches, and deadlines that count down to a fixed date or time in web applications.
useWhen: Countdown timer components for sales, launches, and deadlines that count down to a fixed date or time in web applications.
avoidWhen: Avoid countdown when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Countdown uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
